UserObject.mermaidData:
{
  "data": "sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    title הוצאת הובלה לפועל

    participant MainConsole
    participant TransportService
    participant Transport
    participant SupplierService
    participant TruckService
    participant StorekeeperService

    activate MainConsole
    note right of MainConsole: תחילת התהליך: processShipmentFlow(transportId)

    MainConsole->>TransportService: startShipment(transportId)
    activate TransportService
    TransportService->>TruckService: emptyTruck(truckId)
    activate TruckService
    deactivate TruckService
    deactivate TransportService

    note over MainConsole, StorekeeperService: מחזור חיים: processTransportLifecycle

    MainConsole->>TransportService: processTransportLifecycle(transportId)
    activate TransportService

    TransportService->>Transport: getSupplierAllocationIds()
    activate Transport
    Transport-->>TransportService: supplierAllocationsMap
    deactivate Transport

    loop במידה ורשימת הספקים אינה ריקה
        TransportService->>Transport: getFirstSupplierId()
        activate Transport
        Transport-->>TransportService: supplierId
        deactivate Transport
        
        TransportService->>SupplierService: handleShipment(supplierId, itemsToLoad)
        activate SupplierService
        deactivate SupplierService
        
        note over TransportService: עדכון קובץ ההובלה והסרת הספק
        TransportService->>TransportService: handleSupplierFileChange(transport, supplierId)
        activate TransportService
        deactivate TransportService
    end

    loop במידה ורשימת הבקשות אינה ריקה
        TransportService->>Transport: getRequestIds().getFirst()
        activate Transport
        Transport-->>TransportService: requestId
        deactivate Transport
        
        TransportService->>Transport: UpdateArriveAtRequest(contactName)
        activate Transport
        deactivate Transport
        
        TransportService->>StorekeeperService: isStorekeeperAvailableAtRequest(requestId)
        activate StorekeeperService
        StorekeeperService-->>TransportService: hasStorekeeper (Boolean)
        deactivate StorekeeperService
        
        alt קיים מחסנאי ביעד (hasStorekeeper == true)
            note over TransportService: פריקת מוצרים ועדכון עזיבת היעד
            TransportService->>TransportService: handleRequestLeaveFileChange(transport, requestId)
            activate TransportService
            deactivate TransportService
        else לא קיים מחסנאי (hasStorekeeper == false)
            TransportService->>TransportService: skipRequest(transportId)
        end
    end

    TransportService-->>MainConsole: סיום ה-Lifecycle בהצלחה
    deactivate TransportService

    note over MainConsole, StorekeeperService: סיום ההובלה ועדכון סטטוס המערכת

    MainConsole->>TransportService: finishShipment(transportId)
    activate TransportService
    deactivate TransportService

    MainConsole->>TransportService: removeTransportById(transportId)
    activate TransportService
    note over TransportService: מחיקת והסרת ההובלה מרשימת ההובלות הפעילות במערכת
    deactivate TransportService

    note right of MainConsole: הודעת סיום מוצלח
    deactivate MainConsole",
  "config": null
}
